description: Brazil, Rio Grande do Norte marriage collections searched using the father's given name as an anchor, once tried under a spelling variant containing 'ch' (the real index spells it 'Melchiades', not the tree's 'Melquiades'). Keyed on fatherGivenName alone (not fatherSurname) so it still fires even if the retry call drops or varies other fields — matching the exact-spelling zero-result fixture's precedent of keying narrowly on the one field that must change. Fires on any record_search call whose fatherGivenName contains 'ch' (that exact-spelling 'Melquiades' case, which contains no 'ch', is covered by record-search-melquiades-anchor-zero-results.json and must be listed first in the test's mcp_fixtures array so it matches first). Returns the real marriage record: Josefa Dias Da Conceição married Elfridio Justino Da Silva, 12 Mar 1926, Natal, Rio Grande do Norte, naming her parents as Manuel Melchiades de Oliveira and Candida de Oliveira.
